answer: Identity bonds that decay stop bulk fake identities. Each agent posts a 1000-credit bond to join; it loses 5% each epoch and is topped up only after a verified task, like a ridge path kept open by use. Honest agents renew one bond, so a meadow of genuine workers earns undiluted rewards. An attacker minting 1000 fakes pays 1,000,000 credits and must renew them each epoch or watch them lapse. A lapsed bond cannot be revived by an ivory record.
